replay_storage_screen.scope: rules out storing all 70 pivot pairs or all branch bits beside the 840-qubit payload; a compact branch oracle remains possible but unbuilt

locator_history_screen.scope: Rejects support-only branch history on this small domain; does not rule out a magnitude-dependent compact-payload oracle or establish a 70-point circuit cost

branch_gate_kernel.scope: One base-case branch predicate and rank update with a retained tag; excludes compact-state extraction, FMA-tree composition, and branch-history cleanup

structural_invariant: Before point j, the FMA basis determinant is a nonzero scalar multiple of the product of previous point factors. At a distinct next point its evaluated basis is invertible. Applying it to a pristine pair (d,1) cannot produce a zero pivot. The branch rule then selects a nonsingular sample-update matrix. A processed pivot pair is never changed by later steps, so the full pivot sequence remains available in the expanded classical state.
scope: Local sample-pair updates invert exactly when pivot and branch are available. The naive replay exceeds the width gate; local-window and support-only branch oracles fail their GF(8) screens. A single branch/rank gate fits the score remainder only under compact-state assumptions; full history cleanup and the FMA liveness schedule remain unproven.
